problem: A non-technical AI Product Manager cannot tell whether a model, prompt, retrieval, or agent change is safe to release without asking an engineer to run terminal tools and interpret raw eval output.
target_user: A non-technical AI Product Manager evaluating whether a model, prompt, retrieval, or agent change is safe to release.

primary_journey.description: Open the application in a browser and read a simple explanation of what it does.
Upload the baseline eval-results JSON file.
Upload the candidate eval-results JSON file.
See clear validation errors if either file is malformed or the pair is incompatible.
View pass rates, net change, criterion-level improvements and regressions, newly passing and newly failing traces, hard-gate regressions, the release verdict, and the evidence supporting it.
Filter the changed traces and inspect an individual changed trace in detail.
Download the comparison as Markdown and as JSON.
Start a new comparison without signing in.

screens.name: Upload & Compare
screens.purpose: Explain the product, accept the baseline and candidate files, validate them, and start the comparison.

screens.name: Comparison Dashboard
screens.purpose: Show pass rates, net change, criterion deltas, changed-trace summary, verdict, and evidence; offer Markdown/JSON downloads.

screens.name: Trace Detail
screens.purpose: Inspect one changed trace: per-criterion baseline vs candidate results and the evidence fields.

backend_capabilities.description: Accept baseline and candidate eval-run JSON uploads with size and format limits, processed in memory only.
Validate each file against the eval-run schema and the pair for compatibility (same suite, overlapping criteria, matchable trace ids).
Compute the deterministic comparison: overall pass rates, net change, criterion-level deltas, newly passing/failing traces, hard-gate regressions.
Evaluate release rules and emit PROCEED, HOLD, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with trace-level evidence and explicit reasons.
Generate downloadable Markdown and JSON comparison reports.

api_contracts.purpose: Upload baseline + candidate, validate, and return the full typed comparison with verdict and evidence.
Return the comparison as a downloadable Markdown or JSON report.

accessibility_requirements: Every form control has an accessible label.
The primary journey is completable with keyboard only, with visible focus.
Automated accessibility checks (axe) pass on every screen of the primary journey.
Status changes (loading, errors, verdict) are announced to assistive technology.
responsive_requirements: The primary journey works on a desktop viewport (>=1280px).
The primary journey works on a mobile viewport (375px) without horizontal scrolling.

binary_release_gates.description: The full primary journey passes browser E2E against the real backend and the built preview artifact.
Hard-gate regression fixtures produce HOLD; clean fixtures produce PROCEED; sparse fixtures produce INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Accessibility and mobile checks pass on the primary journey.
Identical inputs produce identical verdicts and reports (determinism).

guardrails: No uploaded data sent to third-party services.
No uploaded result files permanently stored.
Reviewed, tested, and deployed artifact digest-identical.

deployment_target.description: Docker Compose preview built from the frozen candidate; browser tests run against the built artifact. No cloud deployment in V1; the Vercel/Render/Fly.io seam is documented.

required_approvals: production deployment (out of scope for V1)
